$comment: A derived template (packs/README.md 'Derived templates'): the services pack composed with a painting-company content seed and a plum brand over the sitework register. Everything else — pages, sections, contract, tests — is the base pack's; compose expands this catalog through resolveCatalog (scripts/lib/pack-switch.mjs).
title: House painting
description: A painting company site: interior and exterior services with honest starting prices, draggable before/after repaint transformations, a live open/closed badge with click-to-call, testimonials, credentials, and a quote-request form — a multi-page site edited in one content file.

theme.$comment: Plum over the sitework register's plan-grid ground — the same trades voice as the category's contractor starter, visibly a different company. Marketing pages resolve brand over preset accent, so the overlay re-skins the pages and the app surfaces together. navigation re-pins the shared servicesShell chrome (a declared theme variant outranks the shell prop): the base contractor wears the full-width band, so the painting remix keeps the inline floating card — the nav-variety audit spreads the nine-template services family across the vocabulary.
